name: Sphere Tracing with Shading
definition: A shading extension of the sphere tracing system that derives surface normals from the SDF using finite differences, calculates diffuse lighting in world space, and combines a base color with computed light.
summary: Sphere Tracing with Shading renders shaded SDF geometry without meshes by estimating normals via finite differences and applying Lambertian lighting, unlike basic sphere tracing which returns flat colors.
